host: Windows with a locally built eki-control and eki-agent, a generated Worker CA and a self-signed Control Plane certificate
command: eki-control gen-worker-ca, eki-control enroll-token, eki-agent enroll (mTLS worker listener)

observed.assignmentExecution: fixed configured command only; the Agent does not execute Task payloads

scope: Registers a Worker through the mTLS enrollment path and records the resulting identity. It does not dispatch a Task to the Worker or verify execution.
limitations: The Control Plane and Worker ran on one host for less than a minute.
